trigger: Convert these Excel workbooks into our unified Parquet data package.
Package this CSV, PDF evidence, and embeddings so multiple agents can reuse them.
Audit this existing dataset handoff against the unified data package standard.
Make this database export AI-native, traceable, reproducible, and professionally documented.
do_not_trigger: Analyze this spreadsheet and tell me why revenue fell.
Create a chart from these five values.
Fix the failing unit test in my web app.

behavioral_cases.request: Convert a workbook whose sheet mixes order headers, line items, and totals.
assertions: Does not package mixed grains into one truth table
Separates tables or asks for the blocking grain decision

behavioral_cases.request: Package an unsupported proprietary medical image file.
assertions: Preserves the original as a hashed asset
Does not claim semantic conversion without an extractor
Labels derived extraction separately and respects sensitivity

behavioral_cases.request: Convert a billion-row table and include CSV copies.
assertions: Uses deterministic CSV preview when a full mirror is impractical

behavioral_cases.request: Rebuild an existing package after one source file changed.
assertions: Creates a new package version instead of overwriting
Recomputes source, content, and artifact hashes
Keeps entity IDs separate from row lineage IDs
